dedupe_keys.name: geophires x geothermal techno economic simulator

description: GEOPHIRES is a free and open-source geothermal techno-economic simulator; GEOPHIRES-X is its modernised version 3 framework, which succeeds the legacy GEOPHIRES v2.0. It is developed on GitHub by the US national laboratory formerly known as NREL, now the National Laboratory of the Rockies, with copyright from 2023 and more than 170 tagged releases in the v3 series. It combines reservoir, wellbore, surface plant and economic models to estimate capital and operating costs, instantaneous and lifetime energy production and the levelised cost of energy of a geothermal plant, for reservoir types such as enhanced geothermal systems and doublets and for electricity, direct-use heat and cogeneration. Users can add their own correlations and models, and a web interface is offered. Coverage is not tied to a place. The code is accessible on GitHub under the MIT licence at no cost. Caveats: results depend on user-supplied reservoir and cost parameters. Simulation uses are geothermal power and heat project screening, including supply for district heating. Related records: model-tuw-geophires-interactive-geothermal-simulator adapts GEOPHIRES v2 for Vienna, and model-system-advisor-model-sam covers other renewable plants.
